issue: DistantHorizonsStandalone #52 - Pollution fog does not render in LOD terrain

findings.summary: GTNH pollution fog doesn't affect LOD terrain. DH has its own fog rendering system (GlDhFogRenderer) that may not integrate with GTNH's pollution fog effects.
findings.root_cause: DH renders LODs to separate textures with its own fog shader. GTNH's pollution fog modifies vanilla fog, but DH's separate render pass doesn't pick up these changes. The fog color and density from pollution aren't applied to DH's LOD rendering.
evidence: RenderHelper.java:118-127: disableFog() sets extreme fog values for Angelica
DH fog is separate from vanilla MC fog system

primary.issue: Uses DH fog, not vanilla/pollution fog

gap_analysis.invariant_violated: Environmental effects should apply to all rendering

proposed_fix.approach: Add pollution fog integration or config to disable DH fog and use vanilla
implementation_steps: 1. Detect if pollution mod is active
4. Or disable DH fog when pollution detected

falsification_test.description: If pollution fog still doesn't work after integration, issue is in fog shader
steps: 3. If still broken, check shader uniform binding

confidence_reason: Clear separation between DH and vanilla fog systems
